_comment: Row 709. The gate refuses a shell state seed whose literal a later measurement in the same file also produces, because such a seed makes 'never ran' indistinguishable from 'measured and unresolved' on every surface that later reads the variable. M1 deletes the seed-equals-outcome check, so no finding can ever be raised; M2 narrows the stated population to its first root, so a whole half of the denominator disappears silently. Both are caught by the restored-defect fixture, which is the only node that proves the census can say YES. Every anchor matches structural source text -- a bare branch keyword line and a bare return statement -- and carries no number, quoted value or assignment, so nothing here freezes a re-derived value (row 357).
